name: Cutout.Pro
tagline: Cutout.Pro is an AI image editing platform for background removal, photo retouching, and visual enhancement. Designers and e-commerce teams use it to batch-process product images and clean up visuals without desktop software. It handles complex edges like hair and fur well, and processes images through a web upload or API.
